# steprs

Browser tool for coaxial / stepped hole detection in ISO 10303-21 STEP files. Runs in WebAssembly. No upload. Not CAM.

## Pipeline

1. Parse Part 21 into an arena store
2. Build B-rep (`build_brep`)
3. Detect coaxial clusters (`detect_coaxial_holes`)
4. Return JSON for table + viewer
5. Tessellate with OpenCascade in the browser when possible

## Output fields

- kind (blind / through / etc.)
- label
- diameter and depth (mm)
- segment count
- axis data available in JSON for the viewer

## Stack

- Rust: steprs-core, steprs-schema, steprs-topology, steprs-features, steprs-wasm, steprs-cli
- Web: vanilla JS, Three.js, occt-import-js
- Repo: https://github.com/vladimir-io/step-rs
- Site: https://steprs.dev

## Non-goals

Toolpaths, stock simulation, G-code, cloud file storage.
